chunks: And Aban narrated that he said:
Regarding a man who advances dirhams to another man and pays them to him in another land, he said: “There is no harm in it.”

key_terms.الدَّرَاهِمَ: dirhams, a monetary unit used in financial exchange
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is permissible
key_terms.يَنْقُدُهَا: to pay it out or hand it over as payment
key_terms.يُسْلِفُ: to advance payment or give on credit in a forward transaction

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to advance dirhams to someone and receive payment in another land?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that there is no objection to advancing dirhams to someone and having the payment made in another land. It relates to financial dealings and indicates the permissibility of this form of transaction in principle.
